Card Q&A.a: No, it counts toward a use of [Once Per Turn]. The "your opponent may trash 1 card in their hand" effect allows your opponent to choose whether or not they will discard a card in their hand. The effect will be considered to have activated when they choose whether or not to discard it, therefore it counts as a use of [Once Per Turn].
Card Q&A.q: If my opponent doesn't trash a card in their hand and I don't play a Digimon card from my trash for this card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] effect, does that mean it doesn't count toward a use of [Once Per Turn]?

Effect: [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Your opponent may trash 1 card in their hand. If this effect didn't trash, you may play 1 [Fallen Angel] trait Digimon card with a play cost of 7 or less from your trash without paying the cost.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When your opponent's hand is trashed from, if [Barbamon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, trash your opponent's top security card.
